notes: Steps follow README's 'virtual environment' path. README also documents a Docker path (README.rst:459-488): docker compose build, docker compose up (the dev entrypoint runs migrate, compile-scss and collectstatic, docker-entrypoint.dev.sh:3-5), then optionally docker compose run --rm web make reset-local-db; Postgres 17 runs in compose. readmeCommands: the secrets.json content and the ALTER USER statements typed inside psql are not shell commands and are omitted; the export line is meant to go into ~/.bashrc followed by 'source ~/.bashrc'; the 'make install' and 'loaddata dashboard_example_data' alternatives are omitted. secrets.json is technically optional (settings fall back to defaults when missing, common.py:17-24), but the DB passwords set in step 4 have to reach Django through it. createsuperuser is listed as a normal step but is only needed to use the admin. make run serves www, docs and dashboard on port 8000 via *.djangoproject.localhost hostnames (an /etc/hosts entry may be needed, README.rst:406-413). uv.lock exists and requirements/*.txt are exported from it, but the docs and CI use pip. Python is pinned ==3.12.* (pyproject.toml:5, CI PYTHON_VERSION 3.12). gettext is needed for compilemessages/update_docs (CI installs it).
